items.html: Now likewise, in the aspect of the encompassing light (Or Makif), there are ten encompassing [lights] of the Keter and ten encompassing [lights] of the Hochma in the head; and also ten encompassing [lights] of the Keter and ten encompassing [lights] of the Hochma from the place of the forehead to the throat. But now we are not occupied with the encompassing [lights] of the head; we shall speak of the encompassing [lights] of the face.
